![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Use the strict lexicographical byte-order comparison helper `compareByteOrder` instead of `compareNatural` to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering of sorted QA rows.

```suggestion
  const sortedQaRows = normalized.qaRows.map((row, index) => ({ ...row, __qa_index: index })).sort((left, right) => (
    compareByteOrder(left.question_key, right.question_key)
    || compareByteOrder(left.precise_crop_source_map_row_id, right.precise_crop_source_map_row_id)
  ));
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Avoid using Intl.Collator with an undefined locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The temporary directory created via `fs.mkdtempSync` is never cleaned up, which can lead to temporary file accumulation and potential disk space exhaustion over time. We should wrap the execution in a `try...finally` block to ensure that the temporary directory is recursively removed if it was created by this function.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When writing unit tests for package validators, explicitly assert that all expected checks are present, pass, and are emitted in strict byte-order by ID, as required by the general rules.

```javascript
    expect(result.validatorResult.summary.validation_status).toBe('pass');
    const checkIds = result.validatorResult.checks.map((c) => c.id);
    expect(checkIds).toEqual([
      'accepted_receipts_replay_validated',
      'no_external_vlm_calls',
      'no_input_diagnostics',
      'readback_counts_present',
      'receipts_do_not_grant_student_display_or_rights',
      'receipts_have_required_replay_fields',
      'schema_version',
      'vlm_metadata_separate_from_deterministic_authority',
      'wave1_rows_have_receipt_or_explicit_blocker',
    ]);
    expect(result.validatorResult.checks.every((c) => c.status === 'pass')).toBe(true);
```
